title: Technical Institute of Physics and Chemistry, Chinese Academy of Sciences
content:
The Technical Institute of Physics and Chemistry (TIPC) of the Chinese Academy of Sciences, based in Beijing, conducts research in functional crystals, low-temperature physics and engineering, applied chemistry and laser technology.

Its researchers have contributed to aerogel science with work on crack-free monolithic silica aerogels prepared by vacuum freeze-drying, rapid synthesis of large-size ceramic aerogels, and flexible aerogel architectures for thermal insulation.

Leveraging this combination of low-temperature engineering and materials chemistry, TIPC cooperates with industry on aerogel processing routes, drying technologies and thermal protection applications.
